result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a lack of formal infrastructure, including missing crosswalks and discontinuous or absent sidewalks. The wide, unmarked roadway and poor pavement condition create a hostile environment for walking in this residential area.

hazards.description: Pedestrians crossing the intersection have no designated or protected space, increasing exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Missing sidewalks
hazards.description: The absence of paved walkways forces pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on unpaved, uneven surfaces.

result.summary: This residential street lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure at the intersection, including marked crosswalks and curb ramps. The wide, unmarked roadway and parked vehicles near the corner create potential sightline issues and an uncontrolled crossing environment.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with sidewalks but a complete lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or pedestrian-specific signage, and parked vehicles near the corners may obstruct visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks at the intersection to guide pedestrians or alert drivers.

hazards.name: Missing Curb Ramps
hazards.description: Lack of sloped transitions makes the crossing inaccessible for people with mobility devices or strollers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners block the view between pedestrians and approaching traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

result.summary: This residential street features sidewalks on both sides, but lacks any marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures. The wide, unmarked roadway and presence of parked cars create significant crossing distances and sightline obstructions for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street can encourage higher vehicle speeds and increases the exposure time for pedestrians crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Continuous street parking blocks sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, especially children, attempting to cross between cars.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven road surfaces present tripping hazards and can affect vehicle handling.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark crossings with high-visibility paint to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical deflection measures to maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential neighborhood.
